title: Foxconn says Iran conflict having limited impact so far
title_zh: 富士康表示伊朗冲突迄今为止影响有限
summary: The ‌U.S. and Israeli ‌conflict with Iran is ​having limited impact on Foxconn, the chairman of the ‌world's largest ⁠electronics maker and Nvidia's key ⁠AI server maker said on Friday.
summary_zh: 美国全球最大电子制造商、英伟达主要人工智能服务器制造商的董事长周五表示，以色列与伊朗的冲突对富士康的影响有限。

title: US Considers Requiring Permits for Nvidia, AMD Global AI Chip Sales
title_zh: 美国考虑向 Nvidia 和 AMD 全球 AI 芯片销售申请许可证
summary: Now, the Trump administration is considering taking a formal role in the industry that would include similarly sweeping powers.
summary_zh: 现在，特朗普政府正在考虑在该行业发挥正式作用，其中包括类似的广泛权力。

title: Wall Street ends lower as Middle East fears push US oil up 8%
title_zh: 由于中东担忧推动美国石油价格上涨 8%，华尔街收低

title: Broadcom well placed for 'generational' AI investment, CIO says
title_zh: 首席信息官表示，博通在“一代”人工智能投资方面处于有利地位
summary: STORY: Broadcom shares jumped on Thursday after the company predicted over $100 billion in AI chip sales next year, signaling rapid share gains in the market dominated by Nvidia.As demand for AI training, inference and automated “agent” systems grows, Ahlsten says companies ar...
summary_zh: 故事：博通公司预计明年 AI 芯片销售额将超过 1000 亿美元，这表明 Nvidia 主导的市场份额将迅速增长，周四该公司股价上涨。随着对 AI 训练、推理和自动化“代理”系统的需求增长，Ahlsten 表示，公司正在...

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures climb with key jobs report set to cap volatile week
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货上涨，关键就业报告将结束本周的波动
summary: Stock markets continue to be dominated by developments in the Middle East as the major gauges are on track for a week of losses.
summary_zh: 股市继续受到中东事态发展的主导，主要股指有望连续一周下跌。

title: F1 season kicks into high gear with new Apple TV streaming deal
title_zh: F1 赛季通过新的 Apple TV 流媒体协议进入高潮
summary: The Formula One is changing lanes in March with Apple TV (AAPL) becoming the exclusive streamer for the international racing league.
summary_zh: 随着 Apple TV (AAPL) 成为国际赛车联盟的独家流媒体，一级方程式赛车将于 3 月改变车道。

title: Earnings live: Marvell stock surges after hours, Costco sinks after earnings beat
title_zh: 财报直播：Marvell 股价盘后飙升，Costco 财报超出预期后下跌
summary: The S&P 500 was on track for double-digit earnings growth, with more than half of companies having reported Q4 results so far.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数有望实现两位数的盈利增长，迄今为止已有超过一半的公司公布了第四季度业绩。

title: Robinhood launches premium credit card to rival top rewards cards
title_zh: Robinhood推出优质信用卡以与顶级奖励卡竞争
summary: Robinhood (HOOD) is expanding beyond trading with the launch of its new Robinhood Platinum Card, a premium credit card aimed at high-end customers. The $695 annual-fee card includes perks like an Amazon One Medical membership, an Oura Ring subscription, and more.
summary_zh: Robinhood (HOOD) 推出新的 Robinhood 白金卡，将业务扩展到交易之外，这是一种针对高端客户的优质信用卡。这张年费 695 美元的卡包含 Amazon One Medical 会员资格、Oura Ring 订阅等福利。

title: Marvell projects strong fiscal 2028 revenue on AI-driven data center boom, shares jump
title_zh: Marvell 预计 2028 财年营收将因人工智能驱动的数据中心繁荣而强劲，股价上涨
summary: Marvell Technology forecast fiscal 2028 revenue above Wall Street estimates on Thursday, signaling robust demand for custom chips and interconnect solutions used in artificial intelligence data centers, sending its shares ‌surging 15% in extended trading.
summary_zh: Marvell Technology 周四预测 2028 财年营收将高于华尔街预期，这表明对人工智能数据中心使用的定制芯片和互连解决方案的强劲需求，导致其股价在盘后交易中飙升 15%。
